command: git show -s --format=%cI <commit>; read reports/full-3801.json and reports/full-3802.json

pilotWindow.basis: All three serial pilot attempts began after the implementation commit; their completed evidence was committed by the end commit. Window deliberately includes debugging, tests and browser validation.

limitations: Exact wall durations for failed pilot attempts 1 and 2 are unavailable; original reports retain missing accounting.
Git commit timestamps supply a conservative workflow window, not a GPU profiler or monotonic elapsed measurement; inferred bound assumes the observed host wall clock did not change.
